bottomlessLungs.mechanicalEffects: Your ability to hold your breath transcends that of mere human ability. When you’re submerged in water, you may move, travel, observe, fight, etc. underwater for a scene without needing to roll to determine how long you can hold your breath. If the time spent underwater lasts longer than one scene (for example: a complex action involving an investigation in a sunken ship) make a Knack Skill roll at the start of the scene. On any successes, the effect carries over. While thematically designed for water, this Knack may also be used to bypass poison gas or deadly spores, or anything else where holding breath for an extended period of time would be a notable advantage. strange echo or reverberation, notable even when you are at rest.
